title: ReConMem: A Graph-Based Dual Memory System for Repository-Oriented Conversations
abstract: arXiv:2611.07759v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based code assistants are increasingly used in iterative repository-level development, where effective assistance requires jointly leveraging evolving conversational history and repository context. Existing memory systems, however, are primarily designed for general-purpose conversations and do not sufficiently coordinate conversational information with the structured code entities to which it refers. We propose ReConMem, a graph-based dual memory system for repository-oriented conversations. ReConMem organizes distilled conversational memories and conversation-relevant code entities into interconnected semantic and structural memory graphs, while maintaining their cross-graph associations as interactions evolve. translated_title: ReConMem：一种面向仓库对话的基于图的双记忆系统
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的代码助手在迭代式仓库级开发中的应用日益增多，在此场景下，有效的辅助需要同时利用不断演变的对话历史和仓库上下文。然而，现有的记忆系统主要是为通用对话设计的，未能充分协调对话信息与其所指的结构化代码实体之间的关系。我们提出了ReConMem，一种面向仓库对话的基于图的双记忆系统。ReConMem将精炼的对话记忆和与对话相关的代码实体组织成相互关联的语义记忆图和结构记忆图，并在交互演变过程中持续维护它们之间的跨图关联。在记忆召回方面，ReConMem通过基于代码草稿的查询锚定将自然语言检索与代码对齐检索相结合，在图内和图间关系上对检索到的信息进行扩展，并对检索到的代码进行压缩……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出ReConMem，一种基于图的双记忆系统，将对话记忆与代码实体分别组织为相互关联的语义图和结构图，并通过结合自然语言与代码对齐的检索机制，实现面向仓库级开发对话的高效记忆召回。
en_tdlr: ReConMem is a graph-based dual memory system that organizes conversational memories and code entities into interconnected semantic and structural memory graphs, enabling effective memory recall for repository-oriented conversations through combined natural-language and code-aligned retrieval.
